question: Vidhya lent Rs. 6000 to Kavya for 3 years at the rate of 4% per annum compound interest. Calculate the amount that Vidhya will get after 3 years.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The effective Compound Interest rate for 3 years at r% is calculated as: 3r . 3r² . r³

For r = 4%, Effective Rate = 3(4) . 3(16) . (64) = 12.4864%

Total Amount = Principal + Interest = 100% + 12.4864% = 112.4864%

Amount = 112.4864% of 6000 = 6749.184 ≈ 6749.18

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 6749.18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Principal (P) = Rs. 6000

⇒ Rate (R) = 4% per annum

⇒ Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)T
